# Public verification fixtures

- `addresses.json`: bip_utils 2.12.2 output for the public BIP39 mnemonic consisting of eleven "abandon" words and "about", with no passphrase. Generated by `scripts/verify-address-vectors.py`; the verification-only Python dependency is not part of the application.
- `polkadot-hub-2005000.scale`: version-15 metadata from Polkadot Hub, fetched 2026-10-13 through `wss://polkadot-asset-hub-rpc.polkadot.io`, specName statemint, specVersion 2005000, transactionVersion 15. `scripts/fetch-polkadot.mjs` records the public RPC context. The fixture is the decoded inner `Some(Vec<u8>)` from Metadata_metadata_at_version(15).

These fixtures are public and disposable. Never send funds to their addresses. Runtime metadata is chain data; the app validates its types and binds its RFC78 hash into the signed transaction.
